clue.text: Blissful Frenchman after draining Sancerre

draining a bottle empties its inside, leaving only the shell of the word

parts.note: the first and last letters of the wine's name
René is a typical French first name

explanation.surface: A Frenchman sits in bliss once he has finished off a bottle of Sancerre, a Loire white wine.
explanation.definitionFit: Serene describes a calm, untroubled state, close in sense to blissful contentment.

clue.text: Way of walking dog adult noted barking

taken as written, to be mixed with the adult letter

explanation.surface: Someone remarks on a grown-up dog that was heard barking.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dog' is not an animal here but a verb, to follow closely, which is what heel means.
explanation.definitionFit: Heel-and-toe is a style of walking, as in race walking, where one foot is always in contact with the ground.

clue.text: Nanny off the booze before noon sure to get in a state

these four letters reordered

explanation.definitionFit: A dry nurse looks after an infant without breastfeeding it, which is essentially a nanny's job.

clue.text: Suffer with cold and perish? I've ripped coats

indicators.note: the words before it act as a coating wrapped around the answer, which sits inside them

parts.note: the end of perish, all of I've and the start of ripped

explanation.surface: Someone shivering in the cold fears they will die, since their coat has been torn.
explanation.walkthrough: SHIV, a slang word for a knife, sits inside the answer, which is how this across entry bears arms.
explanation.definitionFit: To shiver is to tremble involuntarily, the body's response to feeling cold.

clue.text: This lady ventures to secure recipe for fruity drinks

parts.note: the pronoun for a lady being referred to

explanation.walkthrough: The R abbreviation comes from prescriptions, which began with Latin recipe.

clue.text: One thus about to tour Italian port dealing with marks on a map

definitions.text: dealing with marks on a map

indicators.note: touring a place means going round it, so these letters go round the port's name

parts.note: the Roman numeral for one
so means thus, in this way

C stands for circa, about

explanation.surface: Someone about to travel round an Italian port is studying the symbols on a map.
explanation.definitionFit: Isobaric means relating to isobars, the lines of equal pressure drawn on weather maps.

clue.text: Roll up one's sleeves, we hear, to show what all across answers do here

definitions.text: what all across answers do here

indicators.note: we hear says the phrase before it is to be taken by its sound, not its spelling

parts.note: rolling up your sleeves leaves your arms uncovered

explanation.walkthrough: Every across answer hides a weapon: SHIV, ROD, LANCE, BLADE, RIFLE, EPEE, SPEAR, BOW, GAT, COLT and AXE.

clue.text: Felt sorry about wine drinking you reported

indicators.note: drinking takes something inside, so the wine holds the other letter

clue.text: 21's replacement placed on horse

horse is slang for heroin, abbreviated H

explanation.walkthrough: 21 is ABEL; in Genesis Eve says God has given her another child instead of Abel.
explanation.definitionFit: Seth was born to Adam and Eve after Cain killed Abel, and the Bible presents him as Abel's replacement.

clue.text: In love, disheartened debutante frets

indicators.note: in places one piece inside the other, here inside the god of love

parts.note: Eros is the Greek god of love

indicators.note: losing its heart leaves the word with only its outside letters

parts.note: the first and last letters of debutante

explanation.surface: A young woman making her debut, lovesick and downcast, is fretting.
explanation.walkthrough: ROD, gangster slang for a gun, is the weapon inside. 'Frets' looks like worrying, but it is the wearing-away sense.
explanation.definitionFit: To fret is to wear away by rubbing or gnawing, the same as erodes.

clue.text: Can get excited about article in El Pais review, briefly

about means around, so the rearranged letters surround the article

parts.note: the six letters reordered
la is a Spanish definite article, as used in the Spanish newspaper El País

explanation.definitionFit: To glance at something is to look it over quickly, a brief review.

clue.text: Dystopian tale of British boy and drug trafficker

parts.note: B is the abbreviation for British
a lad is a boy
E is slang for the drug ecstasy
a runner smuggles or carries goods illegally

explanation.walkthrough: BLADE is the weapon on show here.
explanation.definitionFit: Blade Runner is Ridley Scott's 1982 film of a dystopian future Los Angeles, based on a Philip K Dick novel.

clue.text: Straightening out urchin's jacket, speaking with menace

indicators.note: a jacket is an outer covering, so only the outside letters of the word are kept

parts.note: the first and last letters of urchin
snarling is talking in an angry, threatening way

explanation.surface: A street urchin is having his jacket straightened while being growled at.
explanation.definitionFit: Unsnarling means untangling, freeing something of knots, which is straightening it out.

clue.text: Peckham wide boy knowing where Dover is

parts.note: Del Boy Trotter is the wheeler-dealer of the British sitcom Only Fools and Horses, set in Peckham, south London
being aware is knowing

explanation.surface: A south London spiv knows where the Kent port of Dover is.
explanation.walkthrough: A wide boy is a British term for a small-time crook. Dover tempts the solver toward Kent, but the American Dover is meant.
explanation.definitionFit: Dover is the capital city of the US state of Delaware.

clue.text: Idiot penning the French verb on the Spanish exams

el is the Spanish for the

explanation.definitionFit: AS levels are a set of exams in the English school system, one stage below full A levels.

clue.text: More than one sweet model flirts round earl

E is the abbreviation for earl

clue.text: Fat entertaining couple after start of spat? This ends the argument

the start of a word is its first letter

a couple is two

clue.text: Tents go into river

parts.note: the Tees is a river in north-east England

clue.text: Will fruit put in drinks finish in lemonade?

parts.note: milkshakes are drinks
a pear is a fruit

indicators.note: the finish of a word is its last letter

parts.note: the last letter of lemonade

parts.note: the first and last letters of fascia

clue.text: Trader knocking 50% off car

parts.note: a merchant is a trader

explanation.definitionFit: Merc is informal British shorthand for a Mercedes-Benz car.

clue.text: President has left the First Lady's child

parts.note: Abe is Abraham Lincoln, the US president
L is the abbreviation for left

e.g. abbreviates exempli gratia, for example
